# DSR Framework White Paper Package

Purpose: Convert DSR theory synthesis materials into a repository-native methodological white paper and release-preparation package.

Canonical source policy: GitHub is the living source of truth; Zenodo should archive versioned GitHub releases and mint DOI metadata. OSF, Octopus, ResearchGate, Academia.edu, OER platforms, Mendeley Data, and Dryad are secondary or derivative channels depending on object type.

Main manuscript: whitepaper/whitepaper_unified.md
Editable chapters: whitepaper/chapters/
Human strategy: publication_strategy.md
Codex handoff: codex_handoff.md
Manual actions: manual_checklist.md
Repo update plan: repo_integration/repo-update-checklist.md
Metadata templates: metadata/
Source reviews and supporting files: sources/

Core claim: DSR can be operationalized as a structured, traceable, validation-ready repository artifact package. The DSR Framework repository is an attempt to implement that operationalization through models, vocabularies, schemas, templates, rubrics, records, crosswalks, examples, metadata, and release controls.

Non-claim: This package does not assert independent external validation, field consensus, empirical utility proof, or L5 archival/publication-ready status.
